university.name: UBIX Institute of Technologies
university.description: Corporate-affiliated college (U-BIX Colleges Inc., formerly U-BIX Institute of Technology) in Muntinlupa, focused on hospitality, tourism, business, and TESDA-accredited service programs with enrollment-to-employment pipelines through the U-BIX Group.
university.tuition: Not published online on official site as of 2026-07-05 — contact admissions for current fee schedule

sources.note: Official higher education page — BS Hospitality Management, BS Tourism Management, BS Business Administration
Official homepage — U-BIX Colleges Inc.; alumni testimonial references BS Operations Management
Official TESDA page — Housekeeping NC II, Caregiving NC II
Official SHS page — Academic and TechPro tracks (excluded from popularCourses)
Runtime website URL (503 Service Unavailable during research; ubixcollegesinc.edu.ph is the live official site)

courses_research_notes: Institution rebranded to U-BIX Colleges Inc. (formerly U-BIX Institute of Technology, Inc.); campus at Km. 21 East Service Road, Sucat, Muntinlupa — not Mandaluyong as runtime states. Official site publicly lists only three baccalaureate programs; BS Operations Management corroborated by official alumni story on homepage. TESDA NC II programs included because they are prominently listed on the official TESDA page. Runtime strengthTags (information-technology, cybersecurity, digital-arts) are not supported by current official program pages — enrichment reflects hospitality/tourism/business/service focus only. Fewer than 8 popularCourses because the official public catalog is small; do not fabricate IT programs.
